# Ed Prather Real Estate

> Trusted Denver and Lakewood, Colorado real estate team of listing agents and buyer's agents, led by Broker/Owner Ed Prather, serving Denver, Lakewood and surrounding Front Range communities from 274 Union Boulevard, Suite 450, Lakewood, CO 80228. Rated 5.0 across more than 1,000 Google reviews, the 13-agent team helps homeowners sell, buyers purchase, and households relocate to or within the Denver metro area.

- Office: 274 Union Boulevard, Suite 450, Lakewood, CO 80228
- Phone: (720) 650-4959
- Email: team@edprather.com
- Google rating: 5.0 across more than 1,000 Google reviews (Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=11397791241119519406)
- Leadership: Ed Prather, Broker/Owner, Colorado native with over 20 years in real estate
- Approach: team-based, with a dedicated specialist for each stage of a client's move
- Full page list: https://www.edprather.com/sitemap.xml

## Services
- [Sell your home in Lakewood or Denver](https://www.edprather.com/sell/): pricing from comparable sales, preparation, marketing, showings, negotiation and closing
- [Home marketing for sellers](https://www.edprather.com/sell/marketing/): how the team presents and promotes a listing
- [Listing preparation](https://www.edprather.com/sell/listing-preparation/): what to repair, clean and organize before a home goes on the market
- [Home valuation](https://www.edprather.com/home-valuation/): request a property-specific pricing review based on nearby sales
- [Buy a home with a buyer's agent](https://www.edprather.com/buy/): search planning, showings, offers, negotiation and closing coordination
- [First-time homebuyers](https://www.edprather.com/buy/first-time-homebuyers/): guidance for buying a first home in the Denver area
- [Sell and buy at the same time](https://www.edprather.com/sell-and-buy/): coordinating a home sale with the next purchase
- [Relocating to Denver](https://www.edprather.com/relocating-to-denver/): help planning a move to the Denver metro and finding a home
